prediction_text: Prediction: Barack Obama wins the 2008 US presidential election — he secures the Democratic nomination over Hillary Clinton and defeats John McCain on 4 November 2008. The Saturn–Uranus opposition exact on Election Day marks the break with the old order: the change candidate (Uranus) displaces the establishment incumbent party (Saturn), not the reverse. Timing: nomination settled by June 2008, general election decided 4 Nov 2008 (date given on card).

Card facts: Obama leads Clinton but has not clinched (May 2008), McCain presumptive Republican nominee, Saturn–Uranus opposition beginning Election Day, last seen 45 years earlier (mid-1960s upheaval cycle).
